hook: Fey Wanderer's Dreadful Strikes adds 1d4 psychic damage once per turn, not per attack.
body: Dreadful Strikes at 3rd level adds 1d4 psychic damage on a weapon hit once per turn, which doesn't stack with Hunter's Mark. Players mistakenly apply it to every attack, but it's a single bonus per turn. Consistent damage comes from leveraging this on every turn, not from hoping for high rolls.
cta: DMs: Remind players Dreadful Strikes is once per turn; enforce it to maintain balance and focus their strategy.

hook: Awakened Tree's Slam hits harder than most parties expect at this level - 3d6 + 4 catches low-AC characters.
body: With an Armor Class of 13 and 59 hit points, the Awakened Tree can absorb a surprising amount of punishment for a Challenge Rating 2 creature. Its Slam attack, dealing 3d6 + 4 bludgeoning damage, can quickly turn the tide against characters who underestimate its offensive capabilities. The mistake is assuming its slow 20-foot movement makes it harmless; positioning it strategically to exploit its reach can punish poor party placement. Treating it as a stationary threat rather than a mobile one is the smarter play.
cta: DMs: Position the Awakened Tree to exploit its 10-foot reach and catch low-AC characters with its 3d6 + 4 Slam.
